classification_rule.SUPERSEDED: The hit is original/frozen text (v1.0.0 json or md) whose exact locus is explicitly named and replaced by a controlling clause in v1.0.1, v1.0.2, or this artifact.
classification_rule.HISTORICAL_QUOTATION: The hit occurs inside v1.0.1, v1.0.2 or this artifact SOLELY as a quoted excerpt of old text, used to identify what is being superseded — it is never asserted as the current state by the artifact containing it.
classification_rule.QUALIFIED: The hit's own claim remains true and uncontradicted by the correction (it describes a different credential, a different hypothetical, a structural safeguard, or a still-open objection that never depended on the corrected premise), so no supersession is needed, though it is read alongside a correction for full context.
classification_rule.STILL_EFFECTIVE: The hit is original/frozen text, not covered by any SUPERSEDED/QUALIFIED disposition above, and its plain reading contradicts ROTATION_ATTESTED_IN_REPOSITORY, PROVIDER_SIDE_CONFIRMATION_UNKNOWN, the ~4-day window, MEDIUM_PENDING_PROVIDER_CONFIRMATION, or the closed NEXT_PUBLIC prohibition.
